title: Army delays detonating "catastrophically hazardous" lead azide amid fear, anger
summary: Modeling predicts plume of neurotoxic lead could reach up to 100 miles away.
llm_summary: The U.S. Army has postponed a planned detonation of lead azide—a highly explosive, lead‑based compound—after public outcry over its extreme toxicity. Computer models show that a blast could launch a plume of neurotoxic lead particles
